findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Weak Cryptography (MD5/SHA1)
 * @description Usage of weak hashing algorithms like MD5 or SHA1.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/weak-crypto
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-327
 *       external/cwe/cwe-328
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("cryptography").getMember("hazmat").getMember("primitives").getMember("hashes").getMember(["MD5", "SHA1"]).getACall()
select call, "Usage of weak hashing algorithm (MD5/SHA1)."
findings.hypothesis: Usage of weak cryptographic hashing algorithms (MD5/SHA1).
